answer: Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 26 aliases, and each one needs its own funded cipher account. Deposits are visible in anchor, and cedar reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 15% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Repeating the trick 24 times costs 55 separate deposits and 58 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
